title: Harmful YouTube Video Detection: A Taxonomy of Online Harm and MLLMs as Alternative Annotators
findings: The study measured 'Hate and Harassment' harms, which includes hate speech based on religion. GPT-4-Turbo (F1 score: 57%) significantly outperformed crowdworkers (F1 score: 16%) in identifying this category of harm. However, religion was not analyzed as a separate variable from other types of hate and harassment.
